title: Created a very short INSIDE-inspired game with one prompt only in Claude
author: PepsiisgUWUd
selftext:
The story is purposely vague but here is the entire story told via visuals in case you are curious:

\>!You control a man named Matthias who lost his job, losing your job immediately makes the government to issue an assassination attempt on you. the Matthias the player controls is actually a dead version of him that the world uses to train his thoughts and brain on AI models that are important for jobs. It creates a paradox, that people need jobs in order to stay alive, but AI is the one firing them, the exact AI that is built on previously fired workers' concious. Matthias's soul experiences the same city he lived in, but it's all a simulation inside a workflow in a company known as ERIDUS!<

prompt was essentially this:

program me a 2.5D game inspired by INSIDE

lore: The story is basically unexplained, it should be explained in visuals, no talking, environment, and atmosphere

the game should be eery, atmospheric, and sad, with a shocking final reveal at the end. 

Gameplay: mostly a 2.5D walking sim, with low amount of puzzles to progress.

P.S. I plan to make a much longer version based off of this
